title: Exterior Home Upgrade Ideas | Stone Siding for Curb Appeal & Value
description: See how this exterior home upgrade added curb appeal and long-term value with stone siding using Arctic Smoke. Real before and after.
text:
Exterior Home Upgrade: A Clean Stone Addition That Improves Curb Appeal and Value
See how adding stone transformed this home’s exterior—creating contrast, structure, and a more finished look without major construction.

Joseph Hajek

Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Joseph, and I worked with this homeowner on a straightforward exterior upgrade designed to improve both appearance and long-term value.

The home was in great condition, but the siding made the exterior feel flat and lacked the contrast needed to really stand out. It didn’t quite reflect the quality of the home itself.

The goal wasn’t to remodel everything—it was to make a smart upgrade that would improve curb appeal while also adding a more durable, finished look.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

A Proven Exterior Upgrade Without a Full Remodel
Updating Vinyl Siding • Remove Vinyl and Install the Stone

Not every upgrade needs to be dramatic to be effective.By adding stone along the lower portion of the home, this project created contrast, structure, and a more grounded appearance, while keeping the existing siding intact.

✅ Remove the vinyl siding and install

✅ No substrate clean up required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Simple Upgrade That Adds Structure and Contrast
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Exterior felt flat and lacked depth

- Needed more contrast and definition

- Improve curb appeal without overbuilding

- Maintain most existing siding

- Make a smart, lasting upgrade

After

The Solution

- Add stone along the lower façade

- Create contrast with siding

- Introduce texture and structure

- Improve overall curb appeal

- Achieve a more finished, high-quality look

What Does an Exterior Home Upgrade Like This Cost?

Most homeowners are surprised how cost-effective upgrades like this can be. Projects like this typically range between $3,500–$7,500, depending on the size of the home and layout. Many homeowners choose upgrades like this to improve both curb appeal and long-term resale value.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels

- Color: Arctic Smoke

- Install: Remove Vinyl and Install

Will This Work on Homes Like Mine?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface.

Is This a Good Upgrade for Resale Value?

Absolutely, over the past several years, the Cost vs Value report has consistently ranked adding faux stone as the #3 highest ROI home improvement project.

Arctic Smoke Color Guide

This color was chosen to create a clean, modern contrast that works across a wide range of home styles while maintaining a natural stone appearance.
